name: Bubblejaw
place: lies in the hot mud channels south of Stiltreach; a line of bubbles shows where it is going
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). A lurker that breathes out through the mud. Its gas bubbles drift onto players and pop with a shove, and it sends a wave of mud down a line. At half health the whole channel belches gas: only the three dry hummocks are safe (stand inside one), while bubbles keep coming.

party.solo: Solo-able at 14 if you know the hummocks.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: A line of bubbles turns toward you. Fast.
The mud opens into a mouth.
say.death: Bubblejaw sinks. One last bubble comes up, and pops.
say.reset: The bubbles drift away down the channel.

bubbles.name: Gas Bubbles
bubbles.say: Fat gas bubbles drift toward you — keep them away from the others!

mud_wave.name: Mud Wave
mud_wave.say: {boss} heaves a wave of mud at {target}!

fen_belch.name: Fen Belch
fen_belch.say: The whole channel belches gas — get onto a dry hummock!

phases.name: Boiling Mud
phases.say: The mud around Bubblejaw starts to boil!
